itemTexts.description: A magical wrapping capable of binding up to five scrolls.
A magical wrapping capable of binding up to five scrolls.
A magical wrapping capable of binding up to five scrolls.
Sturdy shafts that fly straight and true.
A stout stick covered in pitch.
Paper of superior quality needed for the etchings of magical words.
What they lack in taste they more than make up for in nutrition.
A strong coil make of Hemp and Flax.
A highly polished plate of pure silver.
Heavy Iron spikes capable of being driven into the hardest of stone.
In combination with flame this becomes a poor mans fireball.
A fine wine distilled in the sunken city of Waterford
A finer, sturdier blade.
The special alloys and magic dweomer of the blade make this sword an efficient weapon indeed.
A flexible container made of sturdy leather and rendered impermeable; very useful for holding water, especially when one finds oneself lost in an arid region.
Slightly better than the ordinary version of this blade.
Famous for its taste, its bouqet, its richness and its strenght; truly a dwarven mead!
Rich, yet not too bitter or too sweet, it is no wonder that this rhum is so popular among connaisseurs.
The finest wine of the whole southeast of the Realmz continent!
This powerful weapon is essentially unknown on the Realmz continent, since it comes from Anarym. However, rumors say that it will confuse any target it hits.
Perfectly cut, these rubies are sought for their value and their beauty.
Crafted by a master bowyer and enchanted with dweomers to make it aim farther and better.
Rare indeed, these bows combine the best craftmanship and dweomercraft to make them deadly in the hands of any archer.
The weapon of choice of Keryndorhyan Psi-Knights, it can wound not only the flesh but the mind as well.
This fantastic bow was created ages ago by a mysterious -yet legendary- ranger of Anarym, who's name remains unknown in the Realmz.
Forged and crafted by fire giant masters, these armors not only protect against the cold but also provide a boon against the undead.
Forged and crafted by frost giant masters, these armors not only protect against fire but also provide a boon against denizens of Hell and the Abyss.
The first blade of this type was created centuries past by Nelecktran, the first electromancer.
Some say these helms were made ages ago to combat warriors with psionic powers.
It is said that he who wears this helm shall have the contentment of the simpleton.
Also known as "MageBane", it was created to assassinate powerful mages.
The curse of a medusa shall be inflicted on he/she who wears this suit of armor.
An assassin-for-hire, Rhan the Night made his reputation centuries past by slaying mages.
A superb weapon with a powerful dweomer; unfortunately, it turns its owner into a coward.
An armor much sought after by psionicists and psi-warriors.
This magnificent blade has but one purpose only: to slay anything reptilian, including dragons.
These shields were used ages ago against warriors with psionic powers.
A dark terrible weapon; legends say that it holds the essence of a succubus.
The preferred blade of assassins and murderers for hire.
A fantastic dwarven battleaxe, usually given to dwarven heroes.
Light, yet sturdy and of high quality; made of mithril and special dwarven alloys: very well suited by and for its makers.
The regular weapon of dwarven warriors.
Magically reinforced boots, yet as comfortable as regular leather boots.
A shield for heroes ... dwarven ones, that is.
A blade made on the continent of Anarym, nothing is known of this wonderful sword.
A much sought after item by psionicists.
A robe much sought after by psionicists.
A terrible item used by slavers to break the will of their slaves.
Usually a gift offered by enemies to break one's will.
He/she who wears this shall be confused by the world around him/her.
A reinforced leather cap.
A report from some Sharranth royal spy. Just click "Use" in order to read its contents.
Named after the sell-sword Tarylshar Firehair, who uncovered this blade in some lost ruins, the Windrider is said to be able to make his owner lighter than air.
The processed pelt of an animal; great for clothing and warming. Also valuable when sold.
This beautiful ring allows its wearer to fear no lightning.
Created by the legendary enchantress Archonya, this powerful ring is a coveted prize by sorcerers and incantatrixes alike.
Well-balanced daggers that bear a strong dweomer to increase their accuracy.
A rod useful to help one get out fast of those dead-end situations.
This exquisite armor is forged with adamandine, the rare metal that's stronger than mithril.
A perfectly cut gemstone, seeming as pure as ice. It is said that it belonged to the first King of the frost giants, Viborg.
This superb armor was forged in endurinium, the rarest of metals that surpasses even mithril and adamandine.
A superb blade for the true warrior.
A brooch the size of a hand which radiates magic. Its purpose is unknown.
Made of a special mithril-steel alloy, this blade will cut true and through.
A terrible magic item which will turn its possessor into a frigid statue of the coldest of ice.
Seemingly comfortable, these boots have hidden needles which inject the deadliest of poisons, killing their wearer instantly.
This terrible weapon is known to render helpless any victim hit by its bloodthirsty blade.
A burned and damaged letter you found in an abandoned house. Just click "Use" in order to attempt to decipher what you can of its contents.
Legends say that this weapon was forged eons ago by Shanarack, God of Winter. This item will shrink or expand according to the size of its wielder, thus being usable by any warrior.
A better, sharper shortsword, bearing strong dweomers to enhance its efficiency.
For brawny mages, this wonderful weapon enhances its owner's attacks.
Just click "Use" in order to read the contents of this document.
This old, smelly worn out set of pipes will call upon the sewers' most prominent denizens when played.
A gift of the Goddess Tlarantale to her shadow elf high priestesses, this device is said to summon spiders.
These rare scrolls store the spell "destroy magic".
It is said that he/she who studies the writings of such a book shall gain greater knowledge.
A magical tome who's perusal causes an increase of vitality to the reader.
A hastily penciled letter. Just click "Use" in order to read its contents.
A gift of Tlarantale to her priestesses, this terrible weapon consists of six whips in one which animate as venomous serpents when used in melee.
Another gift of Tlarantale to her high priestesses, providing many favors and abilities upon them.
It is said that he (or she) who wears this terrible cloak shall never need fear death ...
Rumored to have been created by Thryx, Goddess of Trickery, these cards come in subsets and allow the use of various magical disguises (or their removal).
Rumored to have been created by Maelstrome, the God of Storms and Tempests, this magic item is said to summon powerful winds to aid its owner.
A lost magic item from Asturia, the lost colony of the ancient Empire of Macremia; no one knows what is its purpose or function.
A crest used to identify members belonging to a shadow elf noble house.
A crest used to identify members belonging to a shadow elf noble house.
A crest used to identify members belonging to a shadow elf noble house.
A crest used to identify members belonging to a shadow elf noble house.
A crest used to identify members belonging to a shadow elf noble house.
A crest used to identify members belonging to a shadow elf noble house.
A crest used to identify members belonging to a shadow elf noble house.
A crest used to identify members belonging to a shadow elf noble house.
Created by highpriests of Dianchuur, God of Health and Healing, and blessed by the god himself, this holy item is said to be able to cure any disease.
An ancient item created by technomages of the lost empire of Telluria. This strange stone allows anyone to speak and understand any mortal language.
These incredibly ancient, priceless, solid-platinum coins bear the mintage of the lost empire of Telluria.
This incredibly ancient, priceless, solid-silver ceremonial art object was forged long ago by craftmasters of the lost empire of Telluria.
These incredibly ancient and priceless gemstones of various shapes and exquisite designs were crafted by jewelers of the lost empire of Macremia.
This incredibly ancient, priceless, solid-gold lamp was once the possession of a noble house of the lost empire of Macremia.
An ancient item which belonged to the legendary Sorcerer-King Khan-Alghuul, it is said to act as a watchful eye for its possessor.
Created millennia past by macremian technomages, this strange orb will nullify magic and destroy it upon command.
Created hundred of years ago by Hasser the Summoner, the whispy smoke trapped in this bottle is said to animate the shadows.
Not much is known about this item, nor about its creator; it is said to be able to create storms of fire.
A letter bearing the seal of Sharranth. Just click "Use" in order to read its contents.
A letter bearing a seal the likelyness of a skeletal dragon claw covered with dripping blood. Just click "Use" in order to read its contents.
Your typical leather pouch made to hang on a belt and to hold coins. Just click "Use" in order to partake its contents!
Just another seal of officialdom, as often used by monarchs and rulers.
A mystical and magical object of great importance to the Dragonheart Dynasty of Lantharond
A strange device, this crystal-like stone radiates so much energy that it must be kept in an insulated box of lead.

monsterDescriptions.text: Long ago a wizard's experiment had gone afoul and this is the result.
Long ago, a wizard's experiment went very wrong, and this is the result.
Large, slow, stupid.  Put it all together, and you have a four- footed eating machine with sharp teeth.
Brutish and not very bright, the dogres are rumored to have resulted from cross-breeding experiments by a mad mage.
Disgusting to behold, the smell of these creatures is a strong clue as to their diet.
Not a true dragon.  Named after their ilk for it is the only beast known that can rival them in brute strength.
A mindless larva.  Nobody knows what this thing will turn into for no one has ever found one in a cocoon state.
A lone adventurer of the Underearth.
Strongest of the good dragons.  This race of dragon kind devotes their entire lives to the destruction of their evil kin.
A gaping maw of immense size makes this mindless foe one to  avoid.
Sickly in appearance, these foul creatures blend into their  surroundings and pounce on the unsuspecting.
A truly fearsome arachnid.  Avoid contact with this eight legged monstrosity, if at all possible.
Created from nonliving parts and given life through arcane magic.  They will serve their creator until destroyed.
One of the greater races of evil dragons, it is said that they easily rival with their red kin in cruelty and evil.
Minotaurs have a stout body that would make even an ogre quake with fright.  These powerful creatures love to engage in combat.
Minotaurs have a stout body that would make even an ogre quake with fright.   These powerful creatures love to engage in combat.
A larger version of the ordinary troll.  The physical strength of these beasts is near god-like.
These small dragons are by no means demure: it is therefore a good thing that they seek to fight evil, like their greater gold kin whom they attempt to emulate.
A lone adventurer lost in the Underearth.
A large filthy rat.  Its bite can cause disease.
A mountainous man-fish.
Though they look fierce, they are not as deadly as one might think.
Large and deadly.  Their saliva contains a strange chemical.  Those that do not save will become deathly afraid.
An old wretch with little to loose in life. Or so it seems ...
A disgusting blind creature of the deep.  Four clawed feet, two tentacles and a trunk that resembles an elephant's, all combine to make this a creature to avoid.
A lurker of sewers, damp caves and crypts. It likes to entangle its victims with its tentacles, then finish them off with its devastating bite.
A giant boar with a bad attitude.
Do not get too close!  If it gets you in a bear hug, you are doomed for sure.
Long dead creatures of a larger race.  Many such creatures were once gnolls, bug bears, ogres or true giants.
Another one of those fanatical servants of the mysterious Overlords.
A real monster.  Unfortunately, this eight-legged monstrosity also has a potent venom.
As primitive and savage as cavemen, yet skilled in smeltering and tool-making.  They usually live in remote deserts or frozen wastes.
Be careful not to fall victim to a bite from one of these.  Their bite has been known to cause paralysis.
A poisonous bite may be the least of your worries if you meet up with one of these vermin.
A strong goblin warrior that has risen above those of more ordinary skill.
Large and brutish.  These simple-minded humanoids survive due to there sheer size.
A powerful cousin to the modern day mountain lion.
Long ago, a tribe of trolls developed the ability to think.  Since then, they have developed a strong tribal society that rivals orcs and goblins.
Strongest of the evil dragons.  Few  have met with one AND LIVED!
Capable of breathing lightning.  Woe to the fools that find themselves in lonely company with one such as this.
One of the weaker races of dragon kind.  A sly mind and a taste for blood make green dragons a force to be feared.
Created from metal parts and given life through arcane magic.  They will serve their creator until destroyed.
A hardy warrior trained for combat.  A true asset to the king.
A true leader of men.  Trusted with the task of keeping the troops in line and loyal to the king.
Above average in both skill and size.
Pressed into service to pay off depts, these troops are not much of a match for those skilled with weapons.
A snake of unbelievable size.  Easily  60 feet in length and as large around as a full-grown bull vusk.
Large and heavily armored, with a bony back plate and horns.  Only a fool would back one of these things into a corner, especially since they are incredibly fast.
Somewhat skilled with weapons.  The preferred weapon is the bow.
A hardy warrior trained for combat among the trees.
A true leader of men.  Trusted with  keeping the troops in line.
Big as a thespian devil cat and twice as mean.  These men are solely paid to keep the troops in line.  They use force if necessary.
In life, a formerly valiant warrior. In death, he is now a cursed pawn of evil.
Standing 8 feet tall or more, these large brutes love to bully those weaker than themselves.
A would be leader of men.  Most die in battle at the hands of their own men if they are not careful.
An experienced leader with the respect of his troops.  Few will question his orders.
Extremely strong for their size, these beasts make excellent warriors.
Filthy claws and teeth make this creature a deadly menace.  Fear it's bite for it can paralize.
Completely mindless.  They are used as shock troops and as food by most other demons.
A common vermin of immense size.
An apparition from beyond the grave.  Neither good nor evil by nature, it is still best to avoid such creatures.
An apparition from beyond the grave and extremely evil by nature.  It's good pactice to stay clear of these whispy creatures.
Large and fierce, this race of giants is evil through and through.
Usually a spirit bound to protect a place; such entities are quite powerful.
One of the better warriors of this race.
A powerful creature of the undead.  These creatures drain your courage.
Large and fierce, this race of giants is evil through and through.
Capable of regenerating, these creatures are almost indestructible.
Power-hungry, he will let nothing prevent him to grow in power and knowledge.
Common in some areas of cold climate.  No dragon in the Realmz can match this breed when it comes to having a heart of pure evil.
Old crypts are the favorite haunt of these foul vermin.
A close cousin to the red dragon.  These creatures are more common in the Abyss than on the material plane.
They sport a nasty chemical attack.  Oh, I guess it may be worth mentioning.  They may split into smaller slimes when killed.
Olive Slime.   Capable of inflicting a strong chemical burn.
This most beguiling of demons preys on the sexual impulses of mortals.  Taking the shape of a beautiful man or woman, they lure unsuspecting souls to their doom.
A creature of the undead.  Their bite can produce paralysis.
A storm of claws and fangs.  Your basic garden variety of giant spider.
Also known as necromancers, these sorcerers delve into the dark arts of necromancy. They usually worship Orcas, God of Horrors and Undeath.
A humanoid raised from the dead to become one of the cursed undead.
Another one of those unnatural beasts roaming the world.
Living on the frigid planes of the Abyss or in remote snowy wastes, this vile race will attack any goodly race on sight.
Pawns of the frost giants.  These weak-minded fools often do the bidding of the giants and fight by their side.
They stand 16 feet at the shoulder. These gargantuan humanoids roam mountain passes of every climate.
Souls that have been damned to roam the astral plane.  If provoked, they can exist on the material plane for short periods.
These beasts are often no more than slaves to the frost giants.  They serve as hands for those that have none.  They are immensly strong.
Another variant of the troll race, yet every bit as dangerous and vicious.
An evil race of Ogre that has great malice for any surface dwelling race.
Harpies are considered among the most evil minded of creatures.
Lurker of sewers, it grabs victims with its powerful tentacles, snaring them for the kill with its bite.
Evil incarnate, these creatures feast of the terror and pain of those they choose as victims.
These dragons are a mix of red and green dragons.
A common orc who claims to have some skill with weapons.
Small and weak.  Goblins band together in large tribes for their own protection.
A golem of some type, created to protect or guard areas (or treasures).
The chiefson of the minotaur tribe of the Western Lands.
A brave but somewhat unskilled troop.
A conscript with little to look forward to in the civilian world.  For this reason they often reenlist to become corporals.
Charged to keep the troops in line.
Abused as youngsters, these ill- tempered men are but common thugs for hire.
Skilled in the ways of combat and leadership.  An up and coming officer.
A skilled warrior of the dwarven nations.
A larger version of the ordinary troll.  The physical strength of these beasts is near god like.
The kidnapped daughter of the Baron of Koralya.
A huge animal with tusks as long as most men are tall.  Stand aside!   Do not block the path of a rampaging behemoth.
Pickpocket, cutpurse, burglar.  By any name, a thief is a thief.
These reptiles have very hard outer layer skin and a deadly poisonous bite.
A disgusting creature.  This  beast sports four clawed feet, two tentacles and a elephant's trunk.  Its bite can also paralyze, and its spit is corrosive.
An dead warrior brought back to undeath in order to serve an evil master or mistress.
A tamed behemoth who serves as an unstoppable steed of war!
The scourge of desert wastelands, the acid bite of this terror is devastating and its sting-like short tail can paralyze.
Half man.  Half fish.  All bad temper.
Your typical, run-off-the-mill, conscript.
A smaller, but deadly variety of your every day troll.
A special type of mummy enhanced by powerful necromantic dweomers.
Your typical brawny, foolhardy, I'll-do-anything-for-a-fight type of guy.
More wise and intelligent than his peers, he is a good leader and capable strategist.
Capable of casting clerical spells. This humanoid should be feared.
Prefers to feed on the dead.  However, they will not hesitate to add a little fresh meat when it's available.
Belonging to the arachnid family, these large critters pack a paralyzing sting.
Brave and noble Captain of the guards of Lantharond; also quite loyal to his cousin, King Vallarh Dragonheart.
A warrior of great skill and strength.
The priest of a tribe of orcs.
Strong and capable with arms.
A noble Psi-Knight of the mysterious and reclusive people of Keryndorh, an isolationist country of the far-away continent of Anarym.
A kind and wise ranger, yet intent on remaining mysterious and unfathomable to others.
Ratus Gigantus
Skilled in the use of a bow.  These warriors prefer to pepper their enemies with fine hew wood shafts.
A meaner and thougher marauder ... on horse.
The undisputed leader of marauder-rider bands.
A shadow elf found wanting by his unforgiveable people, and thus wickedly turned into a horrible soldier-slave that is half-man, half-spider.
A goblin skilled in the use of a bow.
Fearless warrior and brutish leader.
Proud and honorable Queen of the fallen amazons of Artemisia Forest, she is intent on avenging the ruthless massacre of her tribe.
A noble, selfless, and deserving member of the Order of the Knighthood of the Flame.
Intelligent and considered as evil by all other races, no one can truly fathom what is it that drive these powerful, alien creatures.
Usually a leader or lord of beyonder enclaves.
A noble knight of the Flame and a trusted commander within the Knighthood of the Flame.
The smallest of the goblinoid races, they make up in cunning and ruthlessness for what they lack in size.
The spiritual and mystical leader of kobold tribes.
A favorite game of any serious hunter ... But beware its tusks!
Who ever coined the phrase "weaker sex" obviously has never run into one of these fierce and proud warriors!
The opposite -and nemesis- of any noble and goodly knight.
Warriors with mind powers, they are rumored to come from the land of Keryndorh, which lies secluded in the far-away continent of Anarym.
Expert psi-warrior and leader of psi-warrior companies.
An underground dweller that is more reptile than man.  They hate all surface dwellers.
A stronger and meaner troglodyte.
The strongest, most vile and cunning of his tribe; of course, he now rules his peers!
Resembling ghouls, these vile creatures often live among them.  They are much more powerful than ghouls.
Skilled at arms and tactics, a true example and champion for his peers.
Taller, stronger and more cunning than any other kobold; truly a king fit for them!
Thougher and more cunning than hill giants, they often ally themselves with their lesser cousins when it profits them.
A mixture of pure savagery and cool militarism, this fire giant is usually a leader of a fire giant band or war party.
The undisputed king (or "khan") of fire giants. Need we say more?
A cunning strategist and leader of frost giant war parties.
The undisputed king (or "highlord") of frost giants. Need we say more?
With a shell as dark as soot, this crab is a mindless eating machine with powerful pincers.
With a hard carapace as tough as steel plating, this crab is like a knight in armor.
Large glands in the pincers inject victims with a powerful chemical that bursts into flame when it comes in contact with air.
A gnat less lazy than his peers, and better at doing things. Of course, he's a leader of gnat raiding bands.
Thougher and meaner than his peers, he always assumes leadership in raiding bands ... with, of course, no other ogre to challenge him.
The elite hill giant warrior.
A brute only fit to lead a hunting party of beast men.
The biggest, meanest, and toughest of his tribe ... So of course, he is the king!
While he would much prefer to peacefuly spend his time farming or crafting,  he is not afraid to done armor and weapon to defend his community.
True warriors at heart, these furfoots pledge their lives to protect and defend their bethren.
Spiritual leaders of furfoot communities.
Easily the thoughest of the monster crabs, its powerful pincers will shred you to bits. Its rocky shell in known to be encrusted with gems from time to time.
A true hero and example to his proud peers.
Spiritual leader and warrior of his dwarven bethren.
Once a powerful and dominant god-like race, only a very rare few Titans remain today. This one is among the most vile and ruthless.
She sells her skills at a hefty price, but her skills are indeed grand and deadly!
A better, more experienced rogue. Time to quadruple-lock your doors and chests, folks!
A tenebrous but deadly predator of frozen wastes. Its bite and its breath are as cold as the weather it enjoys living in.
A more northern variety of bears which dwells only in remote snowy or frozen lands.
The highland variety of great cats.
One of the super-predators of nature, wolves are well known to hunt in large pack.
The leader of a pack of wolves.
Undead beings of darkness, they prowl and thrive wherever darkness reigns. Their claws paralyze their victims, the flesh of which they acquire sustenance from.
The psi-warrior epitome; usually a general of psi-warrior armies.
The evil denizens of cursed forests, they lash out with their powerful branches, snaring their victims in order to crush them.
Another dangerous predator of the seas. Beware its deadly sting!
A terrible creature of the darkness; it is said that to see one will paralyze you with fear!
Another fearsome denizen of the Abyssal layers.
Your average I-will-do-anything-for-loot troublemaker ... Sounds familiar?
The lowest of rogues; these louses prey on the weak and thrive on chaos to gain any riches they might come upon.
An adventuring sorcerer who will often lend his skills to the highest bidder.
A devout zealot who often wanders the lands to convert people to his faith.
A wandering mage in search of more magic and power.
A shrewd, bold, troublemaking furfoot.
Although a renegade or exile of her kin, she is still as cunning, as skilled, and as evil!
Hardened veterans of war, they are part of an elite force which serves Anthraxus Storm, the Warlord of Sharranth.
Murderers for hire.
The expert, experienced murderer-for-hire.
A dwarf who seeks fame and fortune ... and do anything to get them.
The fearsome and notorious drow warrior ... need we say more?
Since the drow are legendary for their magic skills and knowledge, is it surprising that powerful sorcerers exist among them?
Not only skilled as a warrior, but deadly accurate as a marksman as well.
Drow females are not only the dominant sex in drow societies, but also devout servants of Tlarantale, the Goddess of Evil, Spiders, and Crawling Creatures.
Usually the ruling Matrons of drow noble houses.
Demonic spiders that are favorite pets of the Goddess Tlarantale. It is said that to kill one is to earn Tlarantale's enimity.
Demonic servants of the Goddess Tlarantale, they act as her representatives to the shadow elves, as well as dispatchers of the dark Goddess' "justice".
A gigantic version of the stingray, which delivers lethal electric charges.
A draconic reptile which roams the deep seas, constantly searching for food.
The scourge of the seas ... and their true master. Albeit somewhat less powerful than its airborne cousins, this dragon still packs a punch!
Pray that you never sail into the path of one of these gargantuan creatures!
The scourge of the seas ...
Captain of his own pirate vessel ... a brutish cutthroat through and through.
Captain of her own pirate vessel ... a brutish cutthroat through and through, yet quite attractive.
These terrible leviatans are feared by every sailor and captain of every continent ...
A dangerous beast. It attacks its victims by using a combination of two of its heads, its front claws and its powerful tail, along with three other heads breathing fire.
Seventh Speaker of the Inner Council of Overlords.
Fourth Speaker of the Inner Council of Overlords ...
Eighth Speaker of the Inner Council of Overlords
The Dread Warlord of Sharranth ...
Daughter of Aquillae, Queen of Coral Towers. A rambuncious, hard-headed young woman, but with a lot of heart and courage.
A priestly monk who serves Astrane, Goddess of the Moons and the Stars, he is a wise man travelling the world in order to better understand it.
Trader of the seas ... and making much profits from it!
One of those rare electromancers,  he usually prefers advancing the knowledge of his craft. However, he will never hesitate to throw his lot in helping to fight the good fight!
Seasoned mariner ... and a not-too-shabby brawler as well.
Sentient mycoroid creatures of the underdark, poddlings are an immature developmental stage of mushmen.
Sentient mycoroid creatures of the underdark.
Evil dwarves, these fell cousins of the dwarven family dwell deep in the underearth, living in dark, clustered, foul-smelling, settlements.
Evil dwarves, these fell cousins of the dwarven family dwell deep in the underearth, living in dark, clustered, foul-smelling settlements.
Spiritual leaders of shadow dwarf communities, these evil beings often serve Orcas, the Dark God of Terror and Undeath.
The (true) high councilor of that name, which you freed from a dark cell in the headquarters of the Red Claw.
Lurkers of sewers, dungeons and caves, beware of their acid secretions.
A half-elf minstrel who happens to be quite talented; very well travelled and knowlegeable, he can wield his weapons as well as he can play (and sing) ballads.
A shadow elf priestess of the noble House of Nys'Raeneen.  She was forced to self-imposed exile to save herself from her mad Matron.
A mercenary with some warrior skills.
A mercenary with some warrior skills, also good with a bow.
A mercenary with some warrior skills, but also a reliable taskmaster.
A seasoned mercenary warrior.
A veteran mercenary warrior, and good leader of men-at-arms.
A mercenary warrior skilled at horse riding.
A seasoned mercenary warrior skilled at horse riding.
Necromancer and worshiper of Orcas, God of Horrors and Undeath, he has sold his services to the Warlord of Sharranth.
The loyal, dedicated, and honorable Captain of the Guards of Wailsrond.
The noble and heroic Kingson of the Dwarven Halls.
A conscript or volunteer, determined to defend his city.
A conscript or volunteer, determined to defend his city.
A professional soldier in the service of Wailsrond.
A professional soldier in the service of Wailsrond.
A small furfoot with a very courageous heart, he seeks to become a True Warrior.
A Vassaleny (Moon) elf, this druid of Lugath (God of Nature) seeks to travel the world in order to gain greater wisdom and knowledge.
Also known as Sapphire Death, this ruthless green dragon loves human flesh and piles of gems.
Having fled the Heartlands because of Sharranth's invasion, he seeks to establish a new base of operations within Tanirith's territories.
This leviathan is legend ... unfortunately, it is very real and very alive!
Also known as Jewel Widow, this emerald wyrm is infamous for its cruelty and greed.
The loyal, dedicated, and honorable Captain of the Guards of Wailsrond.
A most trusted warlord of Anthraxus Storm, he is the commander of the Wailsrond campaign.
A trusted underling of Anthraxus Storm, she is appointed by him as the Herzog of the Heartlands.
The loyal, dedicated, and honorable Captain of the Guards of Wailsrond. Now reduced to a mere zombie, thanks to you.
Men and women of many races and creed hear the call of adventuring. This is one of those greedy, trouble-making folks.
Men and women of many races and creed hear the call of adventuring. This is one of those greedy, trouble-making folks.
Men and women of many races and creed hear the call of adventuring. This is one of those greedy, trouble-making folks.
A war machine, often used by sieging armies.
